final_run.scope: Synthetic local-only Android instrumentation; fake distributor REGISTER/NEW_ENDPOINT and MESSAGE/UNREGISTERED flows, target receiver and notification, process restart persistence, clipboard behavior, preference policy, and injected missing-VAPID refresh fallback.
limits: No live Signal account registration, MollySocket registration, real distributor, or remote push delivery was exercised.
Android 13+ sensitive clipboard metadata was not tested; this emulator is API 30.
Missing-VAPID refresh-job state was explicitly synthetic and took the early-return path before endpoint/network requests.
No real credentials or user account data were used.
